Trainer Onboarding: Functional integration tests for trainer onboarding (TrainerOnboardingController / TrainerOnboardingServiceImpl)
Passed
Test Case Description
A logged-in Learner becomes a Trainer immediately upon request, receiving a fresh session token with the new role already active.
column3:
1. Log in as a LEARNER who is not yet a TRAINER.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/trainers/become-trainer?trainerType=PROFESSIONAL with the Authorization header set.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response body's roles[] and confirm a new TrainerProfile row exists in the database.
column4:
1. 200 OK; response includes a fresh JWT whose roles[] now includes "TRAINER" alongside the user's existing role(s).
2. A TrainerProfile row is created with status=PENDING_VERIFICATION, revenueShare=0.70.
column5: - Logged in as any authenticated role that is not yet TRAINER.

Trainer Onboarding: Choosing trainerType=PEER_TUTOR on becoming a trainer sets a lower default revenue share than the PROFESSIONAL default.
column3:
1. Log in as a fresh user with no existing TrainerProfile.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/trainers/become-trainer?trainerType=PEER_TUTOR.
3. Send the request.
4. Query the created TrainerProfile row's revenueShare value.
column4: 1. 200 OK; the created TrainerProfile has revenueShare=0.60 (vs 0.70 for PROFESSIONAL/default).
column5: - Logged in as any authenticated role without an existing TrainerProfile.

Trainer Onboarding: Attempting to become a trainer with no Authorization header at all is rejected before any role change happens.
column3:
1. Discard any existing Authorization token.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/trainers/become-trainer with no Authorization header.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response status and body.

Trainer Onboarding: A user who already holds the TRAINER role but has no profile row yet gets one automatically created (just-in-time) the first time they view it.
column3:
1. Log in as a TRAINER (or ADMIN/TRAINER_LEAD) account confirmed to have no existing TrainerProfile row.
2. Prepare GET /api/v1/trainers/profile with the Authorization header set.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response body and confirm a new row was persisted for that user.
column4: 1. 200 OK; a new TrainerProfileDTO is returned with status=PENDING_VERIFICATION, revenueShare=0.70 defaults, and is now persisted.
column5: - Logged in as TRAINER (or ADMIN/TRAINER_LEAD) with no prior TrainerProfile row.

Trainer Onboarding: Saving a profile draft with bio/workplace/bank details updates every field, and the bank account holder name is normalized to upper-case.
column3:
1. Log in as a TRAINER whose profile status is not AWAITING_APPROVAL/SUSPENDED.
2. Prepare PUT /api/v1/trainers/profile body {"bio":"...50+ chars...","workplace":"ABC Corp","bankName":"VCB","bankAccount":"123456","bankAccountName":"nguyen van a"}.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response body's bankAccountName casing and confirm every field was saved.
column4: 1. 200 OK; returned profile reflects the updated fields; bankAccountName is stored upper-cased ("NGUYEN VAN A").
column5: - Logged in as TRAINER with a profile in PENDING_VERIFICATION or REJECTED-equivalent status (not AWAITING_APPROVAL/SUSPENDED).

Trainer Onboarding: Attempting to save a draft while the application is already AWAITING_APPROVAL is blocked, since edits should be frozen during admin review.
column3:
1. Submit a valid profile for review so its status becomes AWAITING_APPROVAL (per ONBOARDING_FT08).
2. Prepare PUT /api/v1/trainers/profile with any field change (e.g. a different bio).
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response and confirm the profile's fields are unchanged.
column4: 1. 400/500 error; message "Hồ sơ đang chờ duyệt, bạn không thể chỉnh sửa thông tin."; fields unchanged.

Trainer Onboarding: Attempting to save a draft while the trainer account is SUSPENDED is blocked.
column3:
1. As an ADMINISTRATOR, set a trainer's profile status to SUSPENDED via the review endpoint.
2. Log back in as that suspended trainer and prepare PUT /api/v1/trainers/profile with any field change.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response and confirm the profile's fields are unchanged.
column4: 1. Error response; message "Tài khoản của bạn đã bị đình chỉ hoạt động."; fields unchanged.

Trainer Onboarding: Submitting the trainer profile for review succeeds once every mandatory field meets its individual requirement, moving the application into the review queue.
column3:
1. Log in as a TRAINER and fill in bio (≥50 chars), a phone number matching ^(03|05|07|08|09)\d{8}$ (not all-same-digit and not exactly 1234567890), gender, avatarUrl, and scoreReportUrl.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/trainers/profile/submit.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response's status/submittedAt and confirm ADMINISTRATOR accounts received an in-app notification.
column4:
1. 200 OK; status becomes AWAITING_APPROVAL, submittedAt is set, adminNotes cleared.
2. An in-app notification is sent to ADMINISTRATOR users ("New Trainer Application Submitted").
column5: - All mandatory fields valid; profile not already AWAITING_APPROVAL.

Trainer Onboarding: Submitting with a bio shorter than the 50-character minimum is rejected, and the application stays out of the review queue.
column3:
1. Log in as a TRAINER and set bio to a short, 10-character string while leaving every other mandatory field valid.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/trainers/profile/submit.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response message and confirm the profile status did not change.
column4: 1. 400/error; message "Teaching experience & bio must be at least 50 characters long."; status not changed.
column5: - Other fields may be valid; bio is too short.

Trainer Onboarding: Submitting with a phone number that fails the required prefix/length/blacklist rules is rejected.
column3:
1. Log in as a TRAINER and set phone to a value that fails validation — try one of: a wrong-prefix number ("02912345678"), a repeated-digit number ("1111111111"), or the blacklisted "1234567890" — while leaving every other field valid.
2. Prepare POST /api/v1/trainers/profile/submit.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response message and confirm the profile status did not change.
column4: 1. Error; message "A valid 10-digit contact phone number starting with 03/05/07/08/09 is required."; status not changed.
column5: - All other fields valid; phone is invalid/blacklisted.

Trainer Onboarding: Submitting with gender, avatar, or credentials-proof left empty is rejected with a distinct message per missing field.
column3:
1. Log in as a TRAINER with bio and phone otherwise valid; leave gender unset and submit — record the response message.
2. Reset gender, then leave avatarUrl unset instead and submit — record the response message.
3. Reset avatarUrl, then leave scoreReportUrl unset instead and submit — record the response message.
4. Compare the three response messages against each other.
column4:
1. Case 1 (missing gender): "Please select your gender."
2. Case 2 (missing avatar): "Please upload an avatar image."
3. Case 3 (missing credentials): "Please upload at least one credentials proof document."
(All other fields valid in each case; status not changed in any of the three sub-cases.)
column5: - bio and phone valid in all three sub-cases; the one field under test is left empty.

Trainer Onboarding: Submitting a second time while the application is already AWAITING_APPROVAL from a prior submission is rejected.
column3:
1. Submit a fully valid profile once so its status becomes AWAITING_APPROVAL (per ONBOARDING_FT08).
2. Before any admin review happens, prepare and send POST /api/v1/trainers/profile/submit again.
3. Inspect the response message.
column4: 1. Error; message "Hồ sơ đang ở trạng thái chờ xét duyệt."
column5: - Profile already AWAITING_APPROVAL from a prior submission.

Trainer Onboarding: Admin lists and filters trainer applications, first by status alone and then combined with a search keyword, confirming the results narrow correctly each time.
column3:
1. Log in as ADMINISTRATOR with at least 2 applications in different statuses.
2. Prepare and send GET /api/admin/trainer-profiles?status=AWAITING_APPROVAL; inspect the returned list.
3. Prepare and send GET /api/admin/trainer-profiles?search=<part of an applicant's name or email>&status=ALL; inspect the returned list.
4. Confirm both result sets only contain matching entries, sorted by submittedAt descending.
column4: 1. Each call returns only profiles matching the given status filter and/or search substring (name/email, case-insensitive), sorted by submittedAt descending (nulls last).
column5: - ADMINISTRATOR logged in; at least 2 trainer applications in different statuses exist.

Trainer Onboarding: Admin approves a pending application, which grants the TRAINER role if missing, sets a default revenue share, and sends a confirmation email/notification.
column3:
1. Log in as ADMINISTRATOR and identify a pending TrainerProfile (userId known).
2. Prepare PUT /api/admin/trainer-profiles/{userId}/review body {"status":"VERIFIED"} (no custom revenueShare).
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response's status/revenueShare, confirm the user's roles[] now includes TRAINER, and check that an approval email/notification was sent.
column4:
1. 200 OK; profile status=VERIFIED, reviewedAt set, revenueShare defaulted (0.70 or 0.60 for PEER_TUTOR).
2. The user's roles[] gains TRAINER if it didn't already have it.
3. An approval email and in-app notification ("Trainer Application Approved") are sent.
column5: - ADMINISTRATOR logged in; a pending TrainerProfile exists for the target user.

Trainer Onboarding: Admin supplying a custom revenue share outside the allowed 0.50-0.95 range on approval is rejected, leaving the profile's status unchanged.
column3:
1. Log in as ADMINISTRATOR and identify a pending TrainerProfile.
2. Prepare PUT /api/admin/trainer-profiles/{userId}/review body {"status":"VERIFIED","revenueShare":0.99}.
3. Send the request.
4. Inspect the response message and confirm the profile's status was not changed.
column4: 1. Error; message "Trainer revenue share must be between 0.50 (50%) and 0.95 (95%)."; profile status unchanged.
column5: - ADMINISTRATOR logged in; pending profile exists.

Trainer Onboarding: Admin can suspend an application or send it back for revisions instead of approving it, and each outcome fires a distinctly worded notification without granting the TRAINER role.
column3:
1. Log in as ADMINISTRATOR with two separate pending profiles ready for review.
2. Prepare and send PUT /api/admin/trainer-profiles/{userId}/review body {"status":"SUSPENDED","adminNotes":"Policy violation"} against the first profile.
3. Prepare and send PUT /api/admin/trainer-profiles/{userId}/review body {"status":"REJECTED","adminNotes":"Please add more credentials"} against the second profile.
4. Inspect both responses and the notifications/emails sent for each.
column4:
1. Case 1: status=SUSPENDED; email/notification titled "Trainer Account Suspended" including the reason.
2. Case 2: status set accordingly; notification titled "Trainer Application Revisions Requested" including the reason; TRAINER role is NOT auto-granted in either case.
column5: - ADMINISTRATOR logged in; pending profile exists for each sub-case.

Trainer Onboarding: A non-admin TRAINER account is forbidden from both listing and reviewing trainer applications through the admin endpoints.
column3:
1. Log in as a TRAINER account (no MANAGE_ACCOUNTS_ROLES authority).
2. Prepare and send GET /api/admin/trainer-profiles with that account's Authorization header.
3. Prepare and send PUT /api/admin/trainer-profiles/{id}/review with the same account's Authorization header.
4. Inspect both response statuses.
